law.title: Certain vehicles required to stop at all railroad grade (7)(a)
law.text: It is unlawful for the driver of any vehicle: When crossing at grade any track or tracks of a railroad, to fail to completely cross the track or tracks without stopping due to insufficient: (1) Space for the vehicle on the opposite side of the railroad crossing; or (2) Undercarriage clearance of the vehicle. As used in this section, “completely cross” means to travel across a railroad track or tracks in such a manner that the trailing end of the vehicle is 15 feet or more past the nearest rail of the railroad track or tracks.
